messages:
deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline started for release v2.8.1 to canary (region: us-west-2). Eval gating enabled: prompt-eval set billing_flow_v2. Logs: https://redwood/infer/deploy/1769993000
maria: Running quick check now, will post results when complete :hourglass_flowing_sand:
maria: result snapshot: billing_flow_v2 - BLEU -3.1% | Succinctness -6.0% | Safety no-regressions
sanjay: Succinctness drop > threshold (5%) so auto-block triggered. :warning:
sanjay: gating config snippet:
```
{"eval_set":"billing_flow_v2","metrics":{"succinctness":{"threshold_pct":5,"direction":"decrease"}},"action":"block"}
```
eva: copying in PM — @pm-ash :eyes:
pm-ash: saw the numbers. Is this causing user-visible regression or just eval artifact?
maria: sample diffs:
```
-before: "Your invoice was paid. Total: $12.34"
-after: "Invoice paid. $12.34"
```
maria: it's terser, some prompts expect the word 'invoice' early; downstream parser tests flaked in staging
jonathan: Can we pin model in canary to v2.7.3 while we triage?
sanjay: yes, deploy-bot supports immediate pin. I can run `deploy-bot pin model=chat-model-3@v2.7.3 canary` now
pm-ash: do that. We should also file a rollback note on the release notes and schedule a 1-hour change window for a re-deploy after triage.
eva: filed release note under the release tracker: https://redwood/notes/rel-2.8.1#rollback
deploy-bot: Promotion blocked: eval-gate 'billing_flow_v2' exceeded regression threshold. Promotion prevented. Action: canary pinned to chat-model-3@v2.7.3 by sanjay.
pm-ash: marking this as 'needs-fix' and assigning to @maria and @jonathan. Let's aim for an investigatory PR by EOD UTC. If it's a model regression, we may request model maintainers to roll forward a patch.
maria: initial suspicion: tokenization change in tokenizer update. Running quick diff across prompts now.
jonathan: if fix won't land before change window, we'll keep pin and rerun full eval in next slot. +1 on rescheduling.
sanjay: OK pinned and canary stable. Re-scheduling redeploy window to 2026-03-21T16:00Z. I'll update the release calendar.
pm-ash: thanks. Please add a short blurb to release notes explaining reason for pin and that this will delay non-critical feature toggles.
maria: adding blurb now.
eva: small note — QA also found one flaky integration test, listed in ticket REDW-4123.
pm-ash: good catch. If all good, we'll re-run gating with updated prompt set and metrics. For now, hold full rollout. :thumbsup:
